regulation: UERC Tariff Regulations, 2021 (Reg. 12(10): a true-up surplus or deficit 'shall be carried forward to the ensuing financial year, alongwith carrying cost at the rate of interest applicable for the year of the tariff period, determined in accordance with the Regulation 33') and the 2024 Regulations' counterpart — as the order applies them
note: UERC's carrying cost on a true-up gap as the UPCL FY2026-27 order computes it (Table 3.50): half a year on the year's addition, a full year on the opening balance in a year between, half a year on the opening in the year of recovery; the rate each year's working-capital rate.  The half-year conventions are the order's practice, read from its figures, not quoted Regulation text.
